issues.legal_issue: The Tribunal’s finding that the debts had become bad before the relevant accounting year was supported by material in the record.
material_facts: A substantial debt was recorded in a promissory-note account after the creditor had taken over major assets of the debtor; no interest was charged on that account and no legal steps were taken to recover it.
A separate debt had been reduced to a decree, but the creditor made no effort to execute the decree or recover the amount.
The assessee claimed the debts as bad debts for the relevant accounting year, and the Tribunal found that they had become bad earlier.
issues.conclusion: There was material on which the Tribunal could find that both debts had become bad before the relevant accounting year. The appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: On the question referred under section 66(2) of the Income-tax Act, 1922, the Court considered whether any material supported the Tribunal’s finding, not whether the Tribunal should have reached that finding. The applicable bad-debt requirement, as stated by the High Court, was that the debt be good at the beginning of the relevant accounting year and become bad during that year. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: income_tax_reference_on_material_supporting_a_tribunal_finding and ((substantial_debtor_assets_taken_over and no_interest_charged_on_old_debt and no_recovery_steps_taken) or decree_left_unexecuted)

predicates.income_tax_reference_on_material_support: The proceeding asks whether material supports a tax tribunal’s finding that a debt became bad before the accounting year for which it was claimed.
predicates.substantial_debtor_assets_taken_over: The creditor took over substantial assets of the debtor in connection with the debt.
predicates.no_interest_charged_on_old_debt: The creditor did not charge interest on the old debt account.
predicates.no_recovery_steps_taken: The creditor took no legal steps to recover the old debt.
predicates.decree_left_unexecuted: The creditor obtained a decree for the debt but took no steps to execute it.
predicates.tribunal_finding_of_prior_badness_suppor: The material supports the tribunal’s finding that the debt had become bad before the relevant accounting year.

issues.definition: When a tax reference asks whether material supports a tribunal’s finding of prior badness, the specified asset, interest, recovery, or decree circumstances support that finding.
